2607.24371.title: Closed-Loop Validation-Repair for Healthcare Interoperability: A Multi-Model Study of Schema Compliance in Clinical LLMs
2607.24371.paper_summary: Healthcare interoperability requires AI systems to produce structured outputs conforming to standardized schemas including ICD-10 for diagnostic coding, CPT for procedure billing, and HL7 FHIR for data exchange. While large language models demonstrate clinical reasoning capabilities, their integration into electronic health record systems faces a critical barrier: schema noncompliance. We evaluate three open-source models, Qwen2.5 7B, Llama 3.1 8B, and Gemma2 9B, via local deployment across 320 clinical scenarios spanning ten medical specialties, yielding 960 model-scenario pairs assessed under paired baseline and validation-repair conditions. First, schema noncompliance is consistent across the three model families, with baseline compliance rates ranging from 85.9 to 91.6 percent despite varying architectures and training data, suggesting shared gaps in medical training corpora rather than model-specific limitations. Second, 96 percent of validator-detected failures are representation-level format violations such as alternative medical abbreviations and code prefixes, indicating models follow clinical writing conventions but lack awareness of healthcare IT standards. Third, the validation-repair framework achieves 99.0 percent overall compliance, ranging from 98.4 to 99.4 percent across models, with most errors resolving within one or two iterations. Exact McNemar p-values below 0.001 and absolute improvements of 7.8 to 12.5 percentage points across model sizes confirm statistical significance. These results support closed-loop validation-repair as an effective system-level safeguard for healthcare interoperability, improving schema-level readiness for downstream clinical system integration.
2607.24371.paper_summary_zh: 醫療互操作性要求人工智慧系統產生符合標準化架構的結構化輸出，包括用於診斷編碼的ICD-10、用於程序計費的CPT，以及用於數據交換的HL7 FHIR。雖然大型語言模型顯示出臨床推理能力，但它們在電子健康紀錄系統中的整合面臨一個關鍵障礙：架構不合規。我們通過在320個臨床場景中進行本地部署，評估三個開源模型，分別是Qwen2.5 7B、Llama 3.1 8B和Gemma2 9B，這些場景涵蓋十個醫療專科，產生960對模型-場景，並在配對基準和驗證-修復條件下進行評估。首先，三個模型系列的架構不合規現象是一致的，基準合規率在85.9到91.6之間，儘管架構和訓練數據各異，這表明醫療訓練語料庫存在共同的缺口，而非模型特定的限制。其次，96%的驗證者檢測到的失敗是表現層級的格式違規，例如替代醫療縮寫和代碼前綴，這表明模型遵循臨床寫作慣例，但缺乏對醫療IT標準的認識。第三，驗證-修復框架實現了99.0%的整體合規率，模型之間的合規率範圍為98.4%到99.4%，大多數錯誤在一到兩次迭代內解決。精確的McNemar p值低於0.001，模型大小的絕對改進在7.8到12.5個百分點之間，確認了統計顯著性。這些結果支持閉環驗證-修復作為醫療互操作性的有效系統級保障，提高了下游臨床系統整合的架構級準備度。
